svg.title: A Venturi tube
svg.desc: Fluid flows to the right through a tube with a narrow middle section, the Venturi constriction. The streamlines crowd together in the constriction, where the speed is higher and the pressure lower. That low pressure draws a second fluid, the entrained fluid, in through a narrow side tube on top of the constriction. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A Venturi draws fluid into the constriction
Faster throat flow → lower static pressure → entrainment
Steady flow with negligible entrained volume. The side tube is an inlet, not a manometer.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
A Venturi draws fluid into the constriction
Faster throat flow → lower static pressure → entrainment
Steady flow with negligible entrained volume. The side tube is an inlet, not a manometer.
